meta.defaultDescription: Work out your solar savings and the government grant, then compare up to three quotes from vetted installers in your district. Independent and free for households.

footer.notOfficial: Soley is not a government service. For official information, go to the CEB and the relevant ministry.

home.metaDescription: Work out your solar savings and the new government grant of up to Rs 75,000. Then get up to three quotes from installers we have vetted. Free and independent.
home.title: Solar for your home, without the sales pressure
home.intro: Work out your savings and the government grant. Then get up to three quotes from installers we have vetted in person, and compare them side by side.
home.grantBadge: New grant: up to {amount} back ({share} % of the cost)
home.calculatorIntro: Enter your monthly electricity bill. You can fine-tune the rest.
home.howIntro: Three steps, no obligation and no cost to you.

1.title: Work out your savings
1.body: The calculator estimates the system size, the grant, your net cost and how long it takes to pay back.

2.title: Tell us about your home
2.body: A short form about your roof, your bill and your district. It takes about three minutes.

3.title: Compare up to three quotes
3.body: Vetted installers in your district send a quote. You compare them side by side and choose, or say no to all.

vetted.title: Installers vetted in person
vetted.body: Our team in Mauritius visits every installer and checks documents and finished work before they can send a quote.

independent.title: Independent
independent.body: We do not sell or install panels, and we are not part of the CEB or the government. Every installer pays the same fee per request, so the fee never affects which installers you see.

free.title: Free for households
free.body: You pay nothing, now or later. You are never obliged to accept a quote.

privacy.title: Your details go to three installers at most
privacy.body: Only the installers matched to your request see your details. We never sell them, and you can delete them at any time.

home.grantBody: The Household Rooftop Solar Photovoltaic Grant Scheme was launched in July 2026. It covers {share} % of the cost of an approved system, up to {amount} per household. You can borrow the rest from the Development Bank of Mauritius.
home.warningBody: The CEB has warned that solar systems that are not registered may be disconnected. Every installer on Soley must help you register with the CEB.

cost.a: Nothing for households. Installers pay Soley a fixed fee for each request they accept. That fee is the same for every installer and does not depend on whether you choose them.

who.a: At most three installers matched to your district. Nobody else gets your details. You choose in the form whether they call you, write to you on WhatsApp or e-mail you.

vetting.a: Our team visits each company, checks registration, insurance and certificates, and looks at installations they have finished. Installers who receive repeated complaints are removed.

grant.q: Can I get the government grant?
grant.a: The grant scheme covers {share} % of the cost of an approved system, up to {amount} per household. Check the conditions on the official pages; our grant guide links to them.

official.q: Is Soley part of the CEB or the government?
official.a: No. Soley is an independent private service. We explain the official schemes and link to the official pages, but we do not process grant applications.

obligation.q: Do I have to accept a quote?
obligation.a: No. You can compare the quotes and decline them all. Soley never charges you anything.

home.ctaBody: One short form, up to three quotes, no obligation.
home.heroImageAlt: Illustration of a flat-roofed Mauritian house with solar panels under a bright sun

calculator.metaDescription: Estimate the solar system size, cost, government grant, yearly saving and payback time for your home in Mauritius, from your electricity bill.
calculator.title: Solar savings calculator
calculator.intro: Start with your monthly electricity bill. The calculator estimates the system size, the cost, the government grant, your net cost and the payback time.
calculator.billHint: An average month. Check a recent CEB bill.
calculator.sizingLegend: How should we size the system?
calculator.roofHint: Sunny area free of water tanks and shade.
calculator.regionHint: Used to find installers near you.
calculator.empty: Enter your monthly bill to see an estimate.
calculator.assumptionsIntro: The calculator uses average values. Our team reviews them, and you can see them all here. A real quote replaces them with your installer's actual prices.

assumptions.sunHoursPerDay: Sun: {value} peak sun hours a day

calculator.surplusNote: Surplus electricity can be sold back to the CEB, but the calculator does not count that income, so the real saving may be higher.
calculator.grantNote: Grant: {share} % of the cost of an approved system, up to {max} per household.

footer.independent: Soley is an independent service. We are not the CEB, the government or an installer.
footer.contact: Questions? Reply to this e-mail or write to {email}.

requestReceived.subject: We have your request {reference}
requestReceived.body1: Thank you. Your request {reference} has arrived. We are now matching it with up to three vetted installers in your district.
requestReceived.body2: They will contact you the way you asked, and their quotes will appear in your account so you can compare them side by side. You are never obliged to accept a quote.

adminNewRequest.subject: New request {reference}
adminNewRequest.body: A new quote request {reference} has arrived from {region}.

newLead.subject: New solar request in {region}
newLead.body1: Soley has a new request for you in {region} (electricity bill about {bill} a month).
newLead.body2: Please accept or decline it within 48 hours. You see the household's contact details once you accept. The lead fee only applies to requests you accept.

leadReminder.subject: A household is waiting for your answer
leadReminder.body: You have a request on Soley that you have not answered yet. Please accept or decline it, so the household is not kept waiting.

newQuote.subject: New quote from {company}
newQuote.body1: {company} has sent a quote for your request {reference}.
newQuote.body2: You now have {count, plural, one {# quote} other {# quotes}} to compare side by side. Take your time: you are never obliged to accept.

quoteReminder.subject: Your solar quotes are ready to compare
quoteReminder.body: Your quotes are waiting in your Soley account. When you have chosen, tell us there so the other installers know. If none suits you, you can decline them all.

quoteWon.subject: You were chosen for {reference}
quoteWon.body: Good news: the household chose your quote. Please contact them to confirm the next steps, and help them register the system with the CEB.

quoteLost.subject: Request {reference}: another quote was chosen
quoteLost.body: The household chose another quote this time. Thank you for your offer.

reviewInvite.subject: How did your installation with {company} go?
reviewInvite.body: We hope your solar system is working well. A short review of {company} helps other households in Mauritius choose with confidence.

applicationReceived.subject: We have received your application
applicationReceived.body1: Thank you for applying to become a Soley partner with {company}.
applicationReceived.body2: Our team in Mauritius will check your documents and contact you to arrange a visit. We will let you know our decision by e-mail.

adminNewApplication.subject: New installer application: {company}
adminNewApplication.body: {company} has applied to become a partner installer.

installerApproved.subject: Welcome to Soley
installerApproved.body: {company} is now a vetted Soley partner. You will receive requests from your regions by e-mail. Sign in with this e-mail address to answer them.

installerRejected.subject: Your Soley application
installerRejected.body: Thank you for applying with {company}. We cannot approve the application at the moment. Reply to this e-mail if you have questions or want to apply again later.

magicLink.subject: Your Soley sign-in link
magicLink.body: Use the button below to sign in to Soley. The link works once and expires in one hour. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this e-mail.

quoteForm.metaTitle: Get up to three solar quotes
quoteForm.metaDescription: Tell us about your home and your electricity bill. Soley passes your request to up to three vetted installers in your district. Free, no obligation.
quoteForm.title: Get up to three quotes

quoteForm.draftRestored: We restored the answers you started earlier.

thankYou.title: Thank you, your request has arrived
thankYou.step1: We send your request to up to three vetted installers in your district. You get an e-mail confirmation now.
thankYou.step2: The installers contact you the way you asked, usually within two working days, and may visit to check the roof.
thankYou.step3: Their quotes appear in your account. Sign in with your e-mail address to compare them side by side and choose.
